description: Build the Individual Session Analysis page at /analytics/session/[sessionId] with full session breakdown: header with score/pass-fail, confidence matrix, time analysis chart, subject breakdown, question-by-question detail list with filters, comparison to average, and action buttons
steps: Create src/app/(protected)/analytics/session/[sessionId]/page.tsx as a dynamic route page that imports the SessionAnalysis component

Create src/features/analytics/components/session-analysis.tsx as the main page component. Uses useState(() => ...) lazy initializer to load session via getSession(sessionId), questions via loadAllQuestions(), and compute all analysis data. Has sections A-G as described.

Section A - Session Header: Test date+time formatted nicely, mode badge, large score display (correct/total + %), pass/fail indicator (72% threshold), total time, avg time per question, comparison to personal average (compute from all sessions).

Section B - Confidence Matrix: Beautiful 2x3 grid using buildConfidenceMatrix() from existing utils. Color-coded cells (green shades for correct column, red for incorrect). Key insight text about misconceptions. Each cell clickable to filter the question list below.

Section C - Time Analysis: Lazy-loaded Recharts BarChart (time per question). Highlight bars >90s in red. Average time line overlaid. Stats: fastest, slowest, median. Insight about time traps. Use dynamic(() => import('recharts').then(m => ...), { ssr: false }).

Section D - Subject Performance Breakdown: Table with Subject, Questions count, Correct count, Accuracy %, Avg Time, Confidence distribution. Sorted by accuracy (worst first). Color-coded cells (red <60%, yellow 60-80%, green >80%). Use CFA_SUBJECTS_ORDERED for ordering known subjects.

Section E - Question Detail List: Numbered list of all questions. Each row: number + truncated text, user's answer with check/cross, correct answer if wrong, confidence badge, time spent (red if >90s), subject+topic tag, bookmark/flag indicators. Expandable to show full question + all choices. Filter buttons: Wrong Only, Flagged, Slow >90s, Misconceptions. Sort by number/time/confidence.

Section F - Comparison Section: 'This Session vs Your Average' side-by-side. Score comparison, time/question comparison, guess rate comparison, misconception rate comparison. Mini trend chart of last 10 sessions with current highlighted.

Section G - Action Items: 'Create Flashcards from N Wrong Answers' button (renders BatchFlashcardCreator from @/features/flashcards/components/batch-flashcard-creator), 'Retake This Test' button (navigates to /questions/session with same config), 'Practice Weak Topics' button, 'Export CSV' button (generates and downloads CSV), 'Share Score' button (copies text summary to clipboard).
Add loading state and error handling for invalid/missing session IDs
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with /analytics/session/[sessionId] route in output
Session analysis page loads correctly for a given session ID
Confidence matrix displays 6 cells with correct classification counts
Time analysis chart renders with Recharts (lazy-loaded, no SSR)
Subject breakdown table shows accuracy color-coding
Question list supports filtering (wrong only, flagged, slow, misconceptions)
Action buttons are functional (CSV export, clipboard copy, navigation)
Page handles missing session gracefully with error state
verification: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build
findings: All verification passed: tsc 0 errors, lint 0 warnings, build success with /analytics/session/[sessionId] route visible as dynamic route, all 85 tests pass. Session card links updated from /questions/review/[id] to /analytics/session/[id]. Used useState lazy initializer for localStorage reads. Recharts BarChart and LineChart lazy-loaded with dynamic(). BatchFlashcardCreator integrated for wrong-answer flashcard creation. CSV export generates downloadable file. Share copies text summary to clipboard. Confidence matrix cells are clickable to filter question list. Removed unused CFA_SUBJECTS_ORDERED and QuestionAttempt imports to satisfy eslint.
